title: Tidy up messy names
prompt: data/people.txt has one name per line, typed by different people: odd spacing, ALL CAPS, lower case, and some written 'LAST, First'. Write names.js exporting normaliseName(raw) that returns the name the way you'd print it on a name badge, and tidy.js so that `node tidy.js` rewrites data/people.txt in place with every name normalised. Examples of what we want: '  john  SMITH ' -> 'John Smith', 'SMITH, jane' -> 'Jane Smith', "mary-jane o'brien" -> "Mary-Jane O'Brien". Run it when you're done.

files.data/people.txt:
john  SMITH 
SMITH, jane
mary-jane o'brien
ANNE MARIE  WONG
JONES,  SAM
li,WEI
